description: This file defines a service for resolving project names from project IDs using cross-collection lookups with caching. It includes functions for individual and bulk resolution, utilizing multiple data models such as AppDeployments, Projects, SessionTracking, Costs, Tenants, and Users.

methods.name: getCached
methods.description: Retrieves a cached project name if available and not expired.

methods.name: setCached
methods.description: Stores a project name in cache with a specified TTL.

methods.name: buildProjectIdOrQuery
methods.description: Builds a case-insensitive query to match project ID across multiple possible fields.

methods.name: pickNameFromDeployment
methods.description: Selects the project name from a deployment document based on precedence.

methods.name: pickNameFromProject
methods.description: Selects the project name from a project document.

methods.name: pickNameFromSession
methods.description: Selects the project name from a session tracking document.

methods.name: pickNameFromCost
methods.description: Selects the project name from a cost document.

methods.name: pickNameFromTenant
methods.description: Selects the project name from a tenant document.

methods.name: pickNameFromUser
methods.description: Selects the project name from a user document.

methods.name: lookupProjectName
methods.description: Attempts to find a project name by querying multiple collections in order.

methods.name: resolveProjectName
methods.description: Public function to resolve a project name from a project ID with caching.

methods.name: resolveProjectNames
methods.description: Bulk resolve multiple project IDs to their names, utilizing cache and sequential lookup.
